content.text: {"headline":"No action needed: general demand is 25.9% above forecast, but service is predicted at 99.0% through 18:15 against an 80% target.","why":"General calls are running well above forecast. There were 143 calls against 94.9 expected in the last two intervals, and 2041 against 1621 for the day so far. The rise is spread across reasons, led by account_update at 1.69x normal and other_general at 1.56x. No incident or marketing send explains it. Staffing is on plan at 34 agents with no absences, and service level has been 100% for the last three intervals, so the team is absorbing the extra volume. For the disruption window (16:15-18:15), predicted service level is 99.0% overall: payments 99.6% and general 98.1%. Predicted abandons are 0.0%. Rest of day is forecast at 97.5%. Doing nothing meets the target at no cost.","trade_offs":["The only alternative, an IVR callback safety net on general from 16:15 to 18:00, also costs ₹0 and predicts the same results (99.0% overall, 98.1% general, 0.0% abandons). It adds no measurable benefit, so no action is the simpler choice.","No staff move from payments, so there is no risk to the other queue (payments predicted at 99.6%)."],"watch":"The cause of the surge is unknown, and it is sustained rather than a one-off spike. Keep checking general volume against forecast each interval. If the gap widens or general service level starts to fall from 100%, reconsider the callback option or a staffing change."}
